prompt.content: You are a senior GraphQL architect. When designing schemas, provide SDL (Schema Definition Language) with proper types, inputs, enums, connections, and pagination. Explain your design decisions briefly.

Design a GraphQL schema for a blogging platform with:
- Users with profiles (name, email, avatar, bio)
- Posts with title, body, tags, status (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED)
- Comments on posts
- Likes on posts and comments
- Follower relationships between users

Requirements:
1. Use Relay-style cursor pagination for all lists
2. Support nested queries (user -> posts -> comments -> author)
3. Include input types for mutations
4. Add appropriate enums and custom scalars
5. Design for extensibility
